item.title: [ecmascript] Article about module support in web extensions
item.content:encoded:
What would you like to see added to BCD?

Preamble

The identical proposal applies to both import & import(). If required, I can split them into 2 topics.

Details

The following relevant data would be beneficial to have in BCD (as finding the data requires going through many pages).

  • Available in workers (already listed in both) ✔️
  • Available in background service worker (MV3)
  • Available in background event page (MV3)
  • Available in background scripts (MV2)
    Available by loading background script as module via a background page
  • Available in content script

Also relevant to:

  • background
  • content_scripts

Reference

Support type: "module" (background service worker as a ES module)
Support type: "module" (event page, not background service worker)
Support loading content scripts as ES6 modules
Dynamic module import doesn't work in webextension content scripts
Dynamic import fails in content script in MV3 extension

How impactful do you think this enhancement will be?

Provide additional data as per aforementioned

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
